How easy would it to make your own search engine website now that about 20 years have passed since Google search inception?
There were dozens of search engines before google, and are dozens now today. Not certain what you are after here.
Google's success as a company is not because it has some amazing, fast, revolutionary search engine. Anybody can make one.

I think it would be easier to build a competitive search engine today than it was 10 years ago. Google and several others that I use rarely find what I'm looking for without significant effort and just seem to be getting worse as time passes. There's an opportunity for a search engine that can consistently produce useful results.

It would be easy enough to create a search engine, but to build the technical infrastructure to make it as fast and as useful as google is not as easy. It's not just building a search method to go through lists of stuff to find what you are looking for, google has spent a lot of effort in returning what you want, even if it's not exactly what you are typing. There is a lot of "magic" happening behind the scenes that has become more and more advanced over time.

Sure, there are lots of reasons to not like Google's policies and practices, but at the end of the day I've yet to find a search engine that gives me the results I want without digging for them. I'm talking specifically about work topics, where I am googling an error or a technical problem, 99% of the time the resolution I am looking for will be in the top 10 results. Google tracks other people who searched the same thing, and "upvotes" the pages they stop their search on.

There seems to be some bias for political topics, so maybe there is a niche for a search engine that caters to combating censorship, and political bias, while promoting privacy.
